messages:
maria: Ran the adaptive kernel-sampler perf sweep across H100/A100/L40S. Uploaded memtrace + flamegraph. Short summary: L40S hits a mem-spill slowpath for seq >= 1024 when batch <= 4; selector falls back to paged-flash which is ~2.2x slower than fused for our chat workload. Artifacts: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/2995012345/memtrace.zip

 dan: Oof. Is that reproducible across seeds/runs?

 maria: Yep — 3 seeds x 3 runs each. Low variance. I'll paste the raw numbers below.

 perf-bot: Auto-report: GPU sweep summary (median of runs):
  - H100 seq=512 bsz=4 -> fused p50=48ms p95=102ms mem_peak=9.2GB
  - H100 seq=2048 bsz=1 -> fused p50=170ms p95=320ms mem_peak=10.8GB
  - A100 seq=2048 bsz=1 -> fused p50=210ms p95=400ms mem_peak=11.5GB
  - L40S seq=1024 bsz=4 -> paged-fallback p50=140ms p95=300ms mem_peak=8.6GB
  - L40S seq=2048 bsz=1 -> paged-fallback p50=410ms p95=920ms mem_peak=11.0GB
  NOTE: paged-fallback = kernel selector chose paged-flash / kv-spill path.

 alex: Which heuristic triggered the selector to pick paged-flash? sampler config?

 maria: The test used the default autosampler config with these overrides:
 ```
 ./bench --gpus=L40S --model=redwood-chat-3b 
   --seq-sweep=512,1024,2048 --bsz-sweep=1,4,16 
   --kernel-sampler=adaptive --kv_cache_threshold_bytes=536870912 
   --enable-memtrace --out=artifacts/2995012345
 ```

 alex: kv_cache_threshold_bytes=512MB. On L40S the usable device mem after CUDA driver reservations is smaller; the sampler might be conservative or misestimating. Can you share the memtrace snippet?

 jess: Also: were mixed-sequence batches used or strictly uniform sequences? Mixed seqs can blow up KV due to pad logic.

 maria: Uniform per-run. Memtrace flamegraph: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/2995012345/flamegraph.html
 Sample stack excerpt from runtime log:
 ```
 [2026-03-12T14:02:10Z] KV_ALLOC  alloc_bytes=1147340032  free_estimate=402653184  reason=kv_cache_reserve
 [2026-03-12T14:02:10Z] KV_SPILL_TO_HOST triggered at 1.1GB allocated
 [2026-03-12T14:02:10Z] Selector: evaluated fused (mem_est=1.2GB), paged_flash (mem_est=420MB) -> chose paged_flash
 ```

 dan: That log shows mem_estimates inverted for fused vs paged. If fused mem_est is inflated on L40S we force fallback. Might be a bug in our per-device memory accounting (driver reserved pages, MIG slice differences).

 alex: Quick mitigation: override selector on L40S for seq>1024 to prefer fused, or lower kv_cache_threshold on L40S to avoid host paging. I can run a canary.

 perf-bot: Canary scheduled: 2995012500 by alex. Canary results summary:
  - L40S seq=2048 bsz=1 selector=force-fused -> p50=180ms p95=360ms mem_peak=10.9GB (no OOMs)
  - Baseline (auto) -> p50=410ms p95=920ms mem_peak=11.0GB
  Canary artifact: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/2995012500/canary.zip

 maria: Nice. Looks like fused is both faster and stable for this workload on L40S. I'll open a small PR: (1) selector override for L40S+seq>1024, (2) add device memprobe in sampler init to read real free bytes and account for driver reservations, (3) add a Console metric for kernel-sampler decisions per model/seq so we catch future misroutes.

 jess: :thumbsup: assign me for validation tests covering mixed-seq and varying batch alignments. I'll add regression prompts too.

 alex: FYI I'll also add a short test in the kernel harness to simulate reserved driver memory (subtract 1GB) and assert fused vs paged choice stays sane.

 maria: Follow-ups: PR in a few hours -> #pr/infra/4578, I'll attach memprobe logs. We should also backfill the last week of canary runs for L40S to see if this just recently regressed.

 dan: Sounds good. If the memprobe shows consistent undershoot we should also tweak default kv_cache_threshold_bytes per GPU family.

 perf-bot: Tagging issue: PERF-8243 (kernel-selector misroute on L40S). Auto-linked artifacts: 2995012345, 2995012500.

 maria: Thanks all — I'll post the PR link once ready and schedule a quick 15m sync if anyone wants to review the code path.
